WITH u AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs j SET current_stage='visuals',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE j.id=$1::uuid AND j.content_model_version='staged_v1' AND j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='voiceover'
   AND j.story_package->>'version' IN ('inventory-first-story-v1','visual-facts-story-v1','storyboard-first-v1')
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_segments vs WHERE vs.job_id=j.id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_shots sh WHERE sh.job_id=j.id)
 RETURNING j.id
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) AS ready_to_run;

parameters.jsCode: const stored=$json,reserved=$('Expand Reserved Story Assets').item.json,path=String(stored.visual_path??'').trim(),media=String(stored.media_type??'').trim(),w=Number(stored.width),h=Number(stored.height),bytes=Number(stored.bytes);if(!path||!['image','video'].includes(media)||!Number.isFinite(w)||w<=0||!Number.isFinite(h)||h<=0||!Number.isFinite(bytes)||bytes<=0)throw new Error(`Reserved asset ${reserved.provider}:${reserved.provider_asset_id} returned invalid stored visual`);return {json:{...reserved,visual_path:path,stored_media_type:media,stored_width:w,stored_height:h,stored_bytes:bytes,stored_duration_seconds:Number(stored.duration_seconds??0)||null}};

parameters.query:
WITH existing_segment AS (
 SELECT vs.id,vs.planned_shot_count,vs.status FROM public.visual_segments vs
 WHERE vs.job_id=$1::uuid AND vs.segment_number=$2::int FOR UPDATE
), inserted_segment AS (
 INSERT INTO public.visual_segments(job_id,segment_number,first_scene_number,last_scene_number,start_seconds,end_seconds,duration_seconds,narration,support_evidence_ids,canonical_subject,visual_target,visual_lane,visual_query,visual_description,planned_shot_count,status)
 SELECT $1::uuid,$2::int,$2::int,$2::int,$3::numeric,$4::numeric,($4::numeric-$3::numeric),$5::text,$6::jsonb,$7::text,$8::text,'reference',$8::text,$9::text,$10::smallint,CASE WHEN $10::smallint=1 THEN 'ready' ELSE 'planned' END
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM existing_segment)
 ON CONFLICT(job_id,segment_number) DO NOTHING
 RETURNING id,planned_shot_count,status
), segment AS (
 SELECT id,planned_shot_count,status FROM existing_segment
 UNION ALL
 SELECT id,planned_shot_count,status FROM inserted_segment
 LIMIT 1
), library AS (
 INSERT INTO public.media_library_assets(provider,provider_asset_id,source_url,author,license,license_url,local_path,media_kind,visual_hash,canonical_subject,metadata,last_used_at)
 SELECT $11::text,$12::text,NULLIF($13::text,''),NULLIF($14::text,''),NULLIF($15::text,''),NULLIF($16::text,''),$17::text,$18::text,$19::text,$7::text,$20::jsonb,now() FROM segment
 ON CONFLICT(provider,provider_asset_id) DO UPDATE SET last_used_at=now(),metadata=public.media_library_assets.metadata||EXCLUDED.metadata
 RETURNING id
), inserted AS (
 INSERT INTO public.visual_shots(job_id,visual_segment_id,shot_number,segment_shot_number,start_seconds,end_seconds,duration_seconds,media_library_asset_id,local_path,visual_cluster_key,visual_kind,selection_score,metadata)
 SELECT $1::uuid,segment.id,$23::int,$24::smallint,$25::numeric,$26::numeric,($26::numeric-$25::numeric),library.id,$17::text,$21::text,$22::text,1.0,$20::jsonb FROM segment CROSS JOIN library
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_shots old WHERE old.job_id=$1::uuid AND (old.shot_number=$23::int OR (old.visual_segment_id=segment.id AND old.segment_shot_number=$24::smallint)))
 RETURNING id,visual_segment_id
), completed AS (
 UPDATE public.visual_segments vs SET status='ready',updated_at=now() FROM segment s
 WHERE vs.id=s.id AND s.status='planned' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted_segment ns WHERE ns.id=s.id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.visual_segment_id=vs.id)
   AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM public.visual_shots sh WHERE sh.visual_segment_id=vs.id)+(SELECT count(*) FROM inserted i WHERE i.visual_segment_id=vs.id))=s.planned_shot_count
 RETURNING vs.id
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,$2::int AS unit_number,$23::int AS shot_number,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS persisted,
 (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM completed) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted_segment ns WHERE ns.planned_shot_count=1))) AS segment_completed;

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json),expanded=$('Expand Reserved Story Assets').all().map(x=>x.json),expected=expanded.length;if(!expected||rows.length!==expected)throw new Error(`Reserved visual persistence cardinality ${rows.length}/${expected}`);const shots=new Set();for(const r of rows){if(r.persisted!==true)throw new Error(`Reserved visual shot ${r.shot_number} was not persisted`);shots.add(Number(r.shot_number));}if(shots.size!==expected||[...shots].sort((a,b)=>a-b).some((n,i)=>n!==i+1))throw new Error('Reserved visual persistence shot set is incomplete');const units=new Set(expanded.map(x=>Number(x.unit_number))),storyUnits=Number(expanded[0]?.story_unit_count);if(!storyUnits||units.size!==storyUnits)throw new Error(`Reserved visual unit coverage ${units.size}/${storyUnits}`);return [{json:{job_id:rows[0].job_id,story_unit_count:storyUnits,expected_shot_count:expected}}];

parameters.query:
WITH j AS (SELECT id,status,current_stage,voiceover_duration_seconds,story_package FROM public.jobs WHERE id=$1::uuid AND content_model_version='staged_v1'),
segments AS (SELECT vs.*,lag(vs.end_seconds) OVER(ORDER BY vs.segment_number) previous_end,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY vs.segment_number)::int rn FROM public.visual_segments vs WHERE vs.job_id=$1::uuid),
shots AS (SELECT sh.*,lag(sh.end_seconds) OVER(ORDER BY sh.shot_number) previous_end,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY sh.shot_number)::int rn FROM public.visual_shots sh WHERE sh.job_id=$1::uuid),
q AS (
 SELECT jsonb_array_length(j.story_package->'units')::int expected_count,
   (SELECT count(*)::int FROM segments) segment_count,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM segments WHERE status='ready') ready_segment_count,
   COALESCE((SELECT sum(planned_shot_count)::int FROM segments),0) planned_shot_count,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM shots) shot_count,
   (SELECT count(DISTINCT media_library_asset_id)::int FROM shots) unique_asset_count,(SELECT count(DISTINCT visual_cluster_key)::int FROM shots) unique_cluster_count,
   (SELECT count(*)::int FROM segments WHERE segment_number<>rn OR planned_shot_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR abs(start_seconds-COALESCE(previous_end,0))>0.02 OR abs((end_seconds-start_seconds)-duration_seconds)>0.02 OR status<>'ready') bad_segment_count,
   (SELECT count(*)::int FROM shots WHERE shot_number<>rn OR abs(start_seconds-COALESCE(previous_end,0))>0.02 OR abs((end_seconds-start_seconds)-duration_seconds)>0.02) bad_shot_count,
   COALESCE((SELECT max(duration_seconds) FROM shots),0)::numeric max_shot_duration,COALESCE((SELECT min(duration_seconds) FROM shots),0)::numeric min_shot_duration,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM shots WHERE metadata->>'representation'='exact_media' AND COALESCE((metadata->>'crop_safe_portrait')::boolean,false)<>true) portrait_unsafe_shot_count,COALESCE((SELECT max(end_seconds) FROM shots),0)::numeric final_end
 FROM j
), persisted AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs x SET visual_quality=jsonb_build_object('version',j.story_package->>'version','story_unit_count',q.expected_count,'segment_count',q.segment_count,'shot_count',q.shot_count,'planned_shot_count',q.planned_shot_count,'unique_asset_count',q.unique_asset_count,'unique_visual_cluster_count',q.unique_cluster_count,'max_shot_duration_seconds',round(q.max_shot_duration,4),'reserved_before_script',true,'post_freeze_search_used',false,'pass',(q.expected_count>0 AND q.segment_count=q.expected_count AND q.ready_segment_count=q.expected_count AND q.planned_shot_count=q.shot_count AND q.shot_count>=q.expected_count AND q.unique_asset_count=q.shot_count AND q.unique_cluster_count=q.shot_count AND q.bad_segment_count=0 AND q.bad_shot_count=0 AND q.portrait_unsafe_shot_count=0 AND q.max_shot_duration<=4.5 AND q.min_shot_duration>=1.0 AND abs(q.final_end-j.voiceover_duration_seconds)<=0.02)),updated_at=now()
 FROM j,q WHERE x.id=j.id RETURNING x.visual_quality
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,j.status,j.current_stage,q.*,(SELECT visual_quality FROM persisted LIMIT 1) visual_quality,
 (j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='visuals' AND q.expected_count>0 AND q.segment_count=q.expected_count AND q.ready_segment_count=q.expected_count AND q.planned_shot_count=q.shot_count AND q.shot_count>=q.expected_count AND q.unique_asset_count=q.shot_count AND q.unique_cluster_count=q.shot_count AND q.bad_segment_count=0 AND q.bad_shot_count=0 AND q.portrait_unsafe_shot_count=0 AND q.max_shot_duration<=4.5 AND q.min_shot_duration>=1.0 AND abs(q.final_end-j.voiceover_duration_seconds)<=0.02) all_visuals_ready
FROM j CROSS JOIN q;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json;if(r.all_visuals_ready!==true)throw new Error(`Reserved visual completion failed: segments=${r.ready_segment_count}/${r.expected_count}, shots=${r.shot_count}/${r.planned_shot_count}, assets=${r.unique_asset_count}/${r.shot_count}, clusters=${r.unique_cluster_count}/${r.shot_count}, bad_segments=${r.bad_segment_count}, bad_shots=${r.bad_shot_count}, portrait_unsafe=${r.portrait_unsafe_shot_count}, shot_range=${r.min_shot_duration}-${r.max_shot_duration}`);if(!r.visual_quality||!['inventory-first-story-v1','visual-facts-story-v1','storyboard-first-v1'].includes(r.visual_quality.version)||r.visual_quality.reserved_before_script!==true||r.visual_quality.post_freeze_search_used!==false||r.visual_quality.pass!==true)throw new Error('Durable visual quality was not persisted');return [{json:{job_id:r.job_id,visuals_ready:true,visual_quality:r.visual_quality}}];

const received=$('Receive Job ID').first().json??{};const normalize=v=>String(v??'').trim().toLowerCase();const jobId=normalize(received.job_id||$json.job_id||$json.requested_job_id);if(!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(jobId))throw new Error('Visual failure handler could not recover job_id');const vals=[$json.details?.description,$json.error?.message,$json.error?.description,typeof $json.error==='string'?$json.error:null,$json.message,$json.errorMessage];const message=String(vals.find(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim())||'Visual stage failed').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim().slice(0,4000);return {json:{job_id:jobId,last_error:message}};

parameters.query: UPDATE public.jobs SET status='failed',current_stage='visuals',last_error=$2::text,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING id AS job_id,status,current_stage,last_error;
